description: A two-storey grocer's with a green and cream awning the width of the front. Stands under it hold oranges, tomatoes and cabbage, each with a price ticket. Over the door a neon disc shows a gold 9 with Ration across it in pink script, and OPEN 24 HOURS glows in the window. The door is east; Ironside Street runs west.
name: Ration Nine
